experimental_boundaries: 89 conversion attempt records include preflight failures and retries; not independent model trials.
Reference images were supplied to 17 Pillow/MATLAB cases; R initially had no reference image.
Later MATLAB runtime LUT facts and R CSV/factor metadata use the product reference_files API and are a separate evidence-assisted arm.
The 02bac geometry arm also supplied the measured full-frame viewport and RNG seed to both executors; final contour CData is independently matched, unlike the earlier d9d arm.
The font-facts arm supplied original Pillow draw-call metrics, font hash and shaping advances to both executors through reference_files; it is separate from the source/reference-image-only arm.
Claude bare invocations isolate a confirmed inherited desktop hook stall without modifying user settings; prior stalled/interrupted attempts remain visible.
Repair wall times can include manual confirmation waits; builtin, Claude and Codex thinking settings differ, so elapsed totals are not a speed ranking.
Case oracles and prior candidates were withheld from model projects. Shared general semantic prompt corrections are development on this corpus, not held-out evaluation.
Conversion workers used preinstalled scientific packages; environment repair was tested separately.
Codex used a different model and subscription. Source-bound repair runs now reach actual Tavotto MCP callbacks; earlier setup failures remain separate.
Repeated samples share sources and development feedback; no population success-rate or speed/non-inferiority claim.
Tests overlap and are tied to listed code versions; counts must not be summed.
Fresh app checks include explicit test-client confirmation of offered dependency/run impacts, not automatic production consent.

Both retain antialiasing differences; full surface fidelity and other cameras remain unaccepted. The subsequent same-input a56 builtin trial reads the SVG windows but exhausts its token budget; it is not adopted. Codex again matches frame/ticks and fails surface occlusion (whole RGB MAE 4.93271).

R interval final paired runs match native numeric results and factor order; page layout/font geometry remains unaccepted.
